integrity: The full theorem is proved symbolically and separately checked on 19 small finite-field configurations. No external independent mathematical validation has taken place.
scientific_limitations: Exact formulas hold for the unweighted chain evolution algebra only. The closely related 2020 journal full text was inspected and found not to cover this endomorphism monoid; priority risk remains in other unlocated literature. Finite checks do not replace general proof.
title: Endomorphism rank spectrum and a sharp nilpotent ideal in chain evolution algebras
